label: Synthetic semantic-sweep metadata SQL scale before index change; not semantic, review, or production acceptance
seedAssurance: 32 canonical synthetic fixture Wiki plus short SQL-generated neutral current heads. Their copied binding fingerprints and SQL admission-shaped review/publication rows are not formal independent review or canonical revisions.

queries.headSelectSql:
SELECT h.object_id,h.version_id,
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ccl_knowledge_publications p JOIN ccl_knowledge_reviews v
            ON v.project_id=p.project_id AND v.id=p.review_id
            WHERE p.project_id=r.project_id AND p.changeset_id=r.changeset_id
              AND v.changeset_id=r.changeset_id
              AND v.payload->>'purpose'=$5
              AND (v.payload->>'decision'='approved_for_purpose' OR
                ($5='exploration_reading' AND v.payload->>'decision'='exploration_only'))) AS review_admitted
          FROM ccl_knowledge_heads h JOIN ccl_knowledge_revisions r
            ON r.project_id=h.project_id AND r.object_id=h.object_id AND r.version_id=h.version_id
          WHERE h.project_id=$1 AND r.kind='wiki_page' AND r.published_at IS NOT NULL
            AND r.payload->'binding'->>'spaceId'=$2
            AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR h.object_id::uuid>$3::uuid)
            AND get_byte(uuid_send(h.object_id::uuid),0)%$4=$6
          ORDER BY h.object_id::uuid LIMIT $7

Plans.Filter: ((published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'wiki_page'::text) AND (h.object_id = object_id) AND (((payload -> 'binding'::text) ->> 'spaceId'::text) = 'semantic-scale'::text))
